name: kxtrumpact
title: How many presidential actions will Trump take this week? (Oct 4–10, 2026)
settlement: The market resolves based on the count of items (proclamations, executive orders, nominations & appointments, memoranda) visibly published on the "Presidential Actions" tab at whitehouse.gov, checked at 10:00 AM ET on Oct 11, 2026. Only items with a publication date within Oct 4–10, 2026 count, regardless of legal effect; items on other pages (e.g., Briefings & Statements) or uploaded late do not count.
decideContext: Estimate the effect of news on the weekly count of White House "Presidential Actions" page entries (executive orders, proclamations, memoranda, nominations/appointments) published Oct 4–10, 2026, as it would be tallied at 10:00 AM ET Oct 11, 2026.
